title: Archive through June 2, 2003 - Anonymous (Monday, June 2, 2003 - 07:38 am)
content: The first NDE was an attack. I have a faint memory of being chased and attacked. I became injured when I tried to get away through a wooden fence and a piece of wood went into my abdomen. Then I was somewhere else, like being inside a cloud. I was very young and was singing to Jesus and a man in a long white gown came and took me by the hand. I first asked him about my pet turtle "Harry"(Momma said Harry had gone to live with Jesus and when you go to live with Jesus you don't come back to your home). He said Harry is OK but it was not time for me to come and live with him. That was the first one the second one was due to a reaction to a drug given to me in the hospital. My heart had stopped and I was just watching the people work on me not to worried about the outcome. It was about two a.m. and I was out of my body for a while long enough to go down to the nurses station and list to gossip. They all turned very pale when my heart started up and I got up and asked them about the people they were gossiping about. LOL. The third was also an attack. This time I flew away like superman. The fourth was illness with another reaction to medicine. I have this disorder called Apnea and I would stop breathing at times when I sleep. I had written a journal I really have too much to write it all here. I just have never had anyone to talk to about this. At least not anyone that would not label me crazy, new age, demon possessed or a witch. I hope you will have someone I will be able to talk too. Thank-You, and Bless you.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Watching people work on me in the hospital; then went down to the nurses station and listened to gossip.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Being 'somewhere else, like being inside a cloud.'

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Jesus; also 'a man in a long white gown' who took me by the hand.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Multiple events: attacks (1st and 3rd), drug reaction in hospital with heart stopping (2nd), illness with reaction to medicine and apnea (4th).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Being inside a cloud; singing to Jesus; flying away like superman (third NDE).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Narrative spans four separate NDEs with different elements; OBE and hospital observations are described mainly in the second.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Asked about pet turtle 'Harry' during the first NDE; third NDE: 'I flew away like superman.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Then I was somewhere else, like being inside a cloud.” “He said Harry is OK but it was not time for me to come and live with him.” “My heart had stopped and I was just watching the people work on me not to worried about the outcome.” “I flew away like superman.”
